# Lucan Plumbing

> Lucan Plumbing is a local HVAC company serving Lucan, Middlesex, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.
